ageGate.preRender: body has class age-gate-active; #mainContent has class hidden-content (visibility:hidden; opacity:0) and aria-hidden=true; head style sets body{overflow:hidden}
ageGate.passCheck: Script 1 (DOMContentLoaded): pass if localStorage.agePass_v2==='true' OR sessionStorage.agePass_v2==='true' OR cookie agePass_v2=true -> remove age-gate-active, add age-verified, reveal #mainContent (aria-hidden=false), body overflow/height auto. Script 2 (DOMContentLoaded, STORAGE_MODE='local'): hides #locationGateWrapper; if localStorage pass -> reveal and re-set the cookie when missing; else jQuery('#ageGateModal').modal({backdrop:'static',keyboard:false}).modal('show').
ageGate.yes: #ageGateYes click: #locationGateWrapper display:block, the Yes button opacity 0.33, #ageGateNo display:none. Yes alone does NOT set the pass.
ageGate.no: #ageGateNo click: hide .age-gate-main-body, show .age-gate-denied-body, hide the modal footer. No redirect, nothing stored.
ageGate.storeChoice: click on .location-select-btn inside #locationGate: preventDefault; localStorage.agePass_v2='true'; cookie agePass_v2=true; path=/; max-age=31536000; SameSite=Lax (+ Secure on https); modal('hide'); after 50 ms location.href = the link href (the store page /location/<store>/, not the shop).
ageGate.doesNotSet: The age gate does not set the selected_location cookie; the store page sets it on load (path match in main.js).
ageGate.edgeCase: A visitor whose cookie or sessionStorage holds the pass but whose localStorage does not: script 1 reveals the page, then script 2 still opens the modal because it checks localStorage only. UNVERIFIED in a browser.

components.name: Top-bar store select (#currently-shopping)
components.mechanism: main.js module 343. Runs only if a test cookie can be written, else hides the select. On change: if the option has a value, set cookie selected_location=<data-slug> (30 days, path=/), write data-address into #locationAddress and data-hours (or 'Hours Not Available') into #locationHours, set every .active-location-menu href to data-menu-url (+ data-deep-link when present) and display:inherit (display:none when no menu URL), set every .active-location-directions href to data-directions-url, then navigate to the option value (the store page). On load: the option whose value path equals or prefixes location.pathname is selected (and the cookie set); otherwise the option whose data-slug equals the selected_location cookie is selected. No localStorage is used.

components.name: Order Now buttons (.js-selected-location-menu)
components.mechanism: Click: preventDefault; target = selected option's data-menu-url (+data-deep-link) when the select has a value; else cookie selected_location 'culver-city'/'lax' -> data-lax-url, 'san-pedro'/'sanpedro' -> data-sanpedro-url; navigate when resolved, else open #locationChooserModal. Static href (no JS) = https://werollup.com/location/culver-city/shop/.

components.name: In-content CTAs with .js-location-chooser
components.mechanism: Always open the location chooser modal on click (even when a store is selected); card hrefs come from the button's data-lax-url / data-sanpedro-url. Home buttons: hero 'Order Now' (lax /location/culver-city/shop/, sanpedro /location/san-pedro/shop/), hero 'See Deals' (both /about-us/daily-deals/), 'Delivery' (both /weed-delivery/), and three body buttons 'Order Now' / 'Shop Now' / 'Order Now' with href /shop and the two shop URLs. Static hrefs (no JS) are the a[href] values; /shop is an alias of the Culver City shop.

components.name: ZIP-code delivery finder
components.pages: markup on / only; the script is printed on all 91 pages
components.mechanism: form#zipSearchForm submit: preventDefault; remove .zipcode-error; hide .zcs-hidden-step; if the value is shorter than 5 characters show #zcs1 and append 'Please enter a valid zip code.'; else client-side lookup in two hard-coded arrays: location1zips (22 entries incl. an empty string and duplicates) -> show #location1 (San Pedro); otherwise show #zcs-empty and test location2zips (54 entries incl. duplicates) -> hide #zcs-empty and show #location2 (labelled 'Playa Vista', links /location/culver-city/).
